My name is Carl Gerhard Busch... but I've been known by many aliases... during my long career with the U.S. Government. It's been a humbling job, though I'm hardly known as a humble man. I've been a witness to history, much of it violent. Much of it an abomination of the values Americans hold dear. I've had a privileged seat at the centers of power... held the reins of that power, making sacrifices few are capable of. Of which even fewer still are willing. If people knew the truth, they'd riot in the streets. Too much is made of the will to power, as if our will is free, our choices our own. Our destinies are forged in our bones, made real by a raging impulse to self-destruct. I'm not a bad man. More a practical man. I have taken certain gifts I was given and made good men great. It is my greatness. I'm a father to two men who have figured more in the future than they might ever know. Both would end up working for the FBI... both complex but dedicated men who sacrificed dearly. And in their dogged pursuits would end up paying a terrible price... searching for truths as I parceled them out. Truths held only by the few who know the levers of power... and the invisible hand controlling them. Is there life out there? Good heavens, to doubt it is a failure of more than the imagination. It's a failure to recognize the limits of our own stupidity. The nascency of our science, the rudiment of our tools. We listen, we search, we hope for a sign, as if our eyes and ears are good enough... our brains large enough... our egos small enough. I'm an old man now. I will leave my own mark upon history. More than presidents or tyrants. I don't ask for loyalty and trust... the fleeting bonds of men. I ask only for the years to show my sons and their sons I was right. What their father did had to be done.

entries.location: The Stately House · Mr. Y and Erika Price

entries.text: I see. Nobody has a name.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: The Stately House · Mr. Y and Erika Price

entries.text: We've all had many names.
entries.speaker: Erika Price
entries.location: The Stately House · Mr. Y and Erika Price

entries.text: You wanna see me snap?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: The Stately House · Mr. Y and Erika Price

entries.text: I don't think you're gonna fire that gun, Mr. Mulder. You haven't heard what I have to say. Let me cut to the point. The man we're both looking for is bent--
entries.speaker: Erika Price
entries.location: The Stately House · Mr. Y and Erika Price

entries.text: Hell-bent is what he is.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: The Stately House · Mr. Y and Erika Price

entries.text: --on exterminating humanity.
entries.speaker: Erika Price
entries.location: The Stately House · Mr. Y and Erika Price

entries.text: You'll be pleased to know, Mr. Skinner, I'm here to offer you a deal.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: I don't make deals. This is a waste of time.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: You're still a fairly young man. Years to live, by my estimation. Try me, you son of a bitch.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: I'm the one with the gun.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Not so long ago, mankind's greatest threats were war, famine, and plague. We've all but conquered them with hard science. This faith in technology, our new religion... when a simple pathogen would kill billions and billions. Your immune system will go first, but this is what will finally kill you.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: Are you a party to this?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: His plan is already in motion. The aliens are not coming, Mr. Mulder, just So you understand.
entries.speaker: Mr. Y

entries.text: No interest in a warming planet with vanishing resources.
entries.speaker: Erika Price

entries.text: So just unleash a plague?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: This is no ordinary contagion.
entries.speaker: Mr. Y

entries.text: This is an alien pathogen. The end of history, Mr. Mulder.
entries.speaker: Erika Price

entries.text: And why you have to kill him. The threat is that you'll never see your son again.
entries.speaker: Mr. Y

entries.text: What are you offering me?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Immunity to it.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: In return for what?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Find me the boy, Mr. Skinner.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: He needs the boy, Mr. Mulder.
entries.speaker: Mr. Y

entries.text: He'll never find him.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: You doubt his determination?
entries.speaker: Erika Price

entries.text: He'll use those closest to you.
entries.speaker: Mr. Y

entries.text: What does he want with my son?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: That's the question, isn't it?
entries.speaker: Erika Price

entries.text: He's clearly a very special child.
entries.speaker: Mr. Y

entries.text: Why the hell do you care?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: We want to save humanity.
entries.speaker: Mr. Y

entries.text: He used to want the same. The aliens came to study us... were prepared to work with us.
entries.speaker: Erika Price

entries.text: He was to be the man to lead us.
entries.speaker: Mr. Y

entries.text: But he became destructive, he took only his own counsel.
entries.speaker: Erika Price

entries.text: Understand, I protected mankind as long as I could, Mr. Skinner.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: I see. So you're the hero.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: No one would listen. The aliens brought not only technology... They brought the seeds of our destruction.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: It's what our government would never grasp. And while they were adventuring in Cuba and Vietnam and Central America... I was busy in the Nevada desert dissecting, reverse engineering... playing God with life forms, the stuff of science fiction.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: I had the time, the money, and the freedom to plan for a day I knew would come. You have no idea this man's need to control our fate... How effective and bold his plots and ambitions.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: Oh, my gosh, we did it. That's really the moon?
entries.speaker: Young Jeffrey

entries.text: Yes. That's really the moon, Jeffrey. That's how heroes are made.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: MAN [OVER TV]: Roger. How does it look? Roger.
entries.speaker: Man

entries.text: It's the fourth turning, Mr. Skinner. Civilization is in its final stages. Alliances are crumbling. Truth is fluid and alterable. The only truth left is to survive it.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: And who chooses? You?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: There are people with immunity. Agent Scully has it, and her son. They'll survive with a select few.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: What about Agent Mulder?
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Kill him... before he kills us all.
entries.speaker: Mr. Y

entries.text: You're his son, Mr. Mulder. He won't be expecting you.
entries.speaker: Erika Price

entries.text: You know what I think? That's only half the story. He wants to exterminate humanity... what's your budding enterprise?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: The colonization of space. We're closer than you think. Building Dyson Spheres and magnificent habitable structures.
entries.speaker: Erika Price

entries.text: Oh.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: That's the plan.
entries.speaker: Erika Price

entries.text: A secret space program? I don't think so. I think this is a power play. You want me to kill him so you can implement your own plan. You wanna see blood in the streets. The colonization of space? How do you plan to do that? Transport all humanity off planet? Seven billion people?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: That's not possible. Only a chosen few.
entries.speaker: Erika Price

entries.text: And you call him evil?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: We can take you with us, Mr. Mulder. You and your boy.
entries.speaker: Erika Price

entries.text: You're a liar. You're all liars.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Then no one can save us.
entries.speaker: Erika Price

entries.text: I know someone who can save US. And I think you know her too. Now, get out of my way. I think we're finished here.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Get your ass back in the car.
entries.speaker: Monica Reyes

entries.text: I'm not finished.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: [CELL PHONE BUZZING]

entries.text: Come on, pick up the phone.

entries.text: He's very important to me.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man
entries.location: Mulder on the Road · Skinner's Choice

entries.text: You're asking me to betray them... to betray people that I care about.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner
entries.location: Mulder on the Road · Skinner's Choice

entries.text: Ha, ha. No, no, no. I'm asking you to turn your back on the whole human race.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man
entries.location: Mulder on the Road · Skinner's Choice

entries.text: Come on.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: Mulder on the Road · Skinner's Choice

entries.text: The horror I had felt. The gut wrench of seeing Scully fighting against the storm in her head... now only doubled. Had I come full circle to find the truth? Or only to uncover greater lies? Not one conspiracy but two. They threaten not only Scully, but our son. A drum beats in my heart.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: That man they just wheeled out on a gurney... I know that man. The Smoking Man didn't send him.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: How do you know that?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Because the Smoking Man won't harm me. He's held my life in his hands. That... was something else.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Your visions, Scully... they're not wrong.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: My visions... are from William. I don't know how... but I know that he's guiding me... and you.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: They're looking for him.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: The Smoking Man can't act without William. I know that in my bones. And William knows it. They won't find him... but he will find us.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: So we just wait? Do nothing?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: We do our work. The truth still lies in the X-Files, Mulder.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: They said you were attacked.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: I was calling you.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I didn't get your call.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Where have you been, Skinner? Where have you been?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Leave it alone, Mulder.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: I asked you to look for her.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I looked for her.

entries.text: Where did you look?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: I said leave it alone.

entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: Mulder.

entries.text: Break it up! Break it up! Come on.

entries.text: Whose side are you on?

entries.text: What are you hiding?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: You're not betraying Scully. She'll be with us. She's immune.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: You get off on this, don't you? Ha, ha. Manufacturing destiny? Then why kill Mulder? Mulder would kill me. Scully will never take your offer.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: She'll take it.
entries.speaker: Cigarette-Smoking Man

entries.text: Not without Mulder, she won't.
entries.speaker: Walter Skinner

entries.text: Oh, it's more than that. Dana and I have a history. A very important history that goes back 17 years.
